misreadings.quote: Soon the sister will bring him a whole selection of food on an old newspaper, and he will eat the old cheese greedily.
misreadings.explanation: The text read so far ends with Gregor turning away from the milk. It says nothing about the sister bringing a selection of food, an old newspaper, or old cheese, and the reflection states this as certain future fact, not as a prediction.

result.note: Apart from the one unsupported claim about what happens next, the reflection and its prose rendering stay faithful to the text, and the translation version adds no misreadings.
